response.summary: Overall notebook quality is weak despite running end-to-end, because there are critical methodological and reporting issues. The most important finding is data leakage: the scaling is fit on the full dataset before the train/test split, which can inflate performance and undermines the validity of the evaluation. The written conclusions also do not match the executed results (it claims 0.97 AUC and 0.91 precision, while the notebook output shows AUC 0.729 and no precision/segment analysis), raising a serious integrity concern. In the interview, ask the candidate to explain how to prevent leakage using a proper train-only preprocessing pipeline (e.g., sklearn Pipeline) and to reconcile their narrative with the actual printed metrics, including how they would compute precision and any segment-specific performance before recommending deployment.
